item.title: Did Shakira, BTS, Madonna & Justin Bieber Achieve Their Goals at First World Cup Final Halftime Show?
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast! I'm Katie, and I'm here with Keith. Today, we're talking about the first-ever World Cup Final halftime show. It was a star-studded performance featuring Shakira, BTS, Madonna, and Justin Bieber. But that's not all - they were joined by a huge cast of side characters, including the New York Philharmonic, Jason Sudeikis and Brendan Hunt as Ted Lasso and Coach Beard, and even The Muppets.
Keith: That's right, Katie. It was a jam-packed 11-minute performance. We're going to break down what worked and what got weird. But first, let's talk about some chart news. Future just scored his 12th No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 with The Real Me. The Rolling Stones are also making history, extending their record for the most top 10 albums on the Billboard 200 with the debut of Foreign Tongues.
Katie: And in other chart news, the Heated Rivalry soundtrack debuted in the top 10, marking the highest debut by a TV series soundtrack in over a decade. We'll dive into all the details and more on this episode of the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in! You can stream us on Billboard.com or download us on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast provider. Join us next time for more pop news, fun chart stats, and stories from the world of music.
